message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious aliases were normalized and duplicate entries were merged. The scan window was **2026-10-02 05:10 IST through 2026-10-03 05:10 IST** (2026-10-01 23:40 through 2026-10-02 23:40 UTC).

No credible vulnerability newly reported or materially updated in the last 24 hours could be matched confidently to a product in the assigned primary inventory.

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were confirmed in scope. Candidates outside the exact window, advisories for adjacent products, and vulnerabilities limited to unlisted third-party WordPress plugins or Apache projects were excluded.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector/SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned alerts, GitHub advisories, CVE/NVD-oriented results, CISA sources, and credible security research.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated within the exact 24-hour window. The newest authoritative MongoDB security alerts found by the sweep predated this window.

### Sources checked

- [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories)
- [NVD vulnerability search](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/search)
- [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)
- Vendor security advisory and release-note pages for monitored products

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this scan. Continue routine monitoring and reassess if a vendor later maps a fresh advisory to a monitored product.
